title: Rest And Still Rise (Soul Rise)
style: soul with a two-part arc, brooding 62-68 bpm opening lifting to an upbeat 100-112 bpm groove at the turn, warm piano and round bass foundation, percussion thickening as it lifts, triumphant horn stabs and claps from the turnaround, hopeful minor-to-major resolution, close dry upfront vocal, single continuous take. Warm female lead, sung melody with long held open vowels, rising in register after the turn. The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes. Only the short intro and the final outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them, natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades. Sing the sections in the order written; the song never opens with the hook: build up through the verse first.
negative_tags: rap, rapping, choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery

kie_params.duration: delivered seconds (L-2); G9 headroom question is open decision 3 in file 18

segments.lyrics:
[Intro (spoken): close dry voice, plain speech, no melody]
Running on empty again.

[Vocalise (sung): wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes]
Ooh-oo-ooh, ooh-oo-ooh

[Verse 1 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I rise before the su-un,
the coffee's barely do-one,

[Pre-Chorus (sung): melodic, rising, tempo lifting]
I'm running out of ro-oom,
I'm fading in the glo-oom,

[Verse 2 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The bills stack on the ta-able,
I smile like I am a-able,

[Pre-Chorus 2 (sung): melodic, rising, tempo lifting]
Two in the morning, sti-ill,
I cannot climb this hi-ill,

[Verse 3 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
My daughter saw my fa-ace,
she saw me lose my pla-ace,

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Product (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
She handed me a bo-ook,
The Unhurried Year, look,
Each page said slow and sta-ay,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise,
the morning in your e-eyes

[Bridge (sung): upbeat groove, rising]
I slowed my mornings dow-own,
I laid the heavy crow-own,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise,
the morning in your e-eyes

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise,
the morning in your e-eyes

[Outro (spoken): calm close voice, plain speech, no melody]
The Unhurried Year by Dana Wells. Get the book today.

[End]
